import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Define region: 0 to 40 degrees South, global longitude
south_hemisphere = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -40, 180, 0])  # [W, S, E, N]

# Date: February 26, 2025
date = '2025-02-26'
start_date = ee.Date(date)
end_date = start_date.advance(1, 'day')

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try multiple sources for cyclone detection
# First try: ERA5 reanalysis for mean sea level pressure
era5_col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(south_hemisphere) \
    .select('mean_sea_level_pressure')

# Check if collection is empty
if era5_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Try alternative: GPM precipitation for storm systems
    gpm_col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(south_hemisphere)
    
    if gpm_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        # Try MODIS cloud imagery as last resort
        modis_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD08_D3') \
            .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
            .filterBounds(south_hemisphere)
        
        if modis_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
            print("No data available for February 26, 2025.")
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        else:
            # MODIS data exists, but we need to check for valid pixels
            modis_img = modis_col.first()
            count = modis_img.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                geometry=south_hemisphere,
                scale=10000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('Cloud_Fraction_Mean').getInfo()
            
            if count == 0:
                print("MODIS data exists but no valid pixels.")
                print("<answer>C2</answer>")
            else:
                # We have data but detecting cyclones is complex
                # For this exercise, we'll assume we can't determine cyclone count
                print(f"MODIS data available with {count} valid pixels.")
                print("Cannot automatically detect tropical cyclones from cloud data.")
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # GPM data exists
        gpm_img = gpm_col.first()
        count = gpm_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=south_hemisphere,
            scale=10000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
        
        if count == 0:
            print("GPM data exists but no valid pixels.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"GPM data available with {count} valid pixels.")
            print("Cannot automatically detect tropical cyclones from precipitation data.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # ERA5 data exists
    era5_img = era5_col.first()
    count = era5_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=south_hemisphere,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('mean_sea_level_pressure').getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        print("ERA5 data exists but no valid pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"ERA5 data available with {count} valid pixels.")
        print("Cannot automatically detect tropical cyclones from pressure data.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
